{{Top|leg}}
'''Adapter chips''' were used in conjunction with [[FLR-series Logger Droid|FLR Logger]] [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. Standard FLR Loggers could recognize around 150,000 different [[Tree/Legends|tree]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. An adapter chip could be used to download additional species types to the droid.
